questions.topic: sup over bounded range vs l1
questions.verdict: COLLAPSE_TO_FREE for lam <= 0.618 (trivial bound + sharp floor; 0.361 with in-kernel floor); TRANSFER for lam in (0.62, 0.85]; wall above
questions.wall: SUP WALL: no theorem below the l1 norm for a bounded-range sup of an unstructured trigonometric polynomial; large-value theory bounds counts/measure (V ~ sqrt(GN) regime), reducing to Chebyshev C G/V^2 here (2.6 % at lam = 1, c = T); Kronecker pigeonhole alignment height eps^{-K_p} = 10^123 at lam = 1 is an upper bound only

questions.topic: consistency; fixed-lam envelope positivity as a theorem
questions.verdict: COLLAPSE_TO_FREE (already E6Bridge11 gaussian_positivity_envelope; sharp constant c1 = 2 pi e^{S(lam)} is elementary, proposal P1)
questions.wall: fixed-lam positivity is not RH; resonance/model maxima sigma sqrt(2 log c) are below the floor log(c/2 pi) once log c >~ 2 sigma^2 (inside the ladder), so the residual band is heuristically safe by a factor 1.6-2.5 but only the l1 bound is rigorous

questions.verdict: FOOTHOLD as a lemma (negative-set density C^{1-eta}, prime side only, resolves S10 unconditionally); COLLAPSE_TO_FREE as RH progress; TRANSFER for Lipschitz-grid certification (feasible lam <= 0.8, heroic 0.9, infeasible 1.0)
questions.wall: MOMENT WALL: exceedance level log c needs moment order k ~ log^2 c / sigma^2 but moments match the model only for k <= log c/(3 log N) (LLR Lemma 3.2); Sobolev sup bounds scale with C; Lean: no Montgomery-Vaughan in Mathlib

questions.verdict: TRANSFER (coordinates): prime(c, lam) = 2 Re of Gaussian-smoothed -zeta'/zeta at 1/2 + ic read from Re w = a > 1/2; shifting to Re w = 0 is the explicit formula; S8 is the rational-kernel version
questions.wall: Selberg CLT is the growing-truncation regime with variance (1/2) log log t; fixed lam has fixed variance sigma^2(lam) and a Bohr-Jessen limit law that says nothing at level log c
